text.p: This page is updated daily to reflect the current status of the CSC 2.1. The list of stacks in CSC 2.1 and whether they have completed processing is available as the text file: stacks-2.1.txt. The catalog can also be viewed using the WorldWide Telescope, which lets users select stacks or sources.

CSC 2.1 contains 10034 stacks, comprising of 15533 observation intervals (OBI). There are 10033 stacks (100.0%), containing 15532 observation intervals (100.0%), that have completed processing in CSC 2.1.
In the table below the Stack status column refers to whether the stack is new in CSC 2.1, updated to have more observations than CSC 2.0, or is unchanged from CSC 2.0.
